executed_live: The IT-7 scenario ran against PayPal Sandbox on loopback from 15:58Z to 16:40Z, with the API and the harness's own job drainer on the local Postgres (never the hosted database): PAYMENT_ROUTER=single_seller, PAYMENT_MODE=authorize_capture, WEBHOOKS_ENABLED=false, AI_ENABLED=false. Four buyer fixtures joined through POST /api/v1/intake/manual + POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/entries, each with a signed entry receipt; the agent API joined, listed and withdrew; the MCP endpoint ran initialize, tools/list, enter_pool, list_entries and withdraw_entry; the console merchant quoted, bid and confirmed and the key merchant bid through PUT /merchant-api/v1/lots/{lot_id}/bid; the deliberate off-product bid produced a LOW_SIMILARITY WARNING; both lots awarded; checkout opened with three offers and one waitlisted entry. The owner approved lot 1 ($470) and lot 2 ($490) through the redirect approvals; lot 1 reached FUNDED on capture 67454261HL110735P (47000 cents, COMPLETED on a direct GET) against authorization 2VH97627V7221553V. One lot-2 offer expired and lot.refill offered the seat to the waitlist (wave 1). Lot 2 ended FAILED_CLOSED at the fund deadline with authorization 98034989X7549701W VOIDED (void_source lot_failing) and a zero money ledger.
what_this_proves: The whole Phase 7 surface works on a running server with real provider objects: the agent and MCP lanes join/list/withdraw through the same validator and join service as the browser, the merchant key lane bids through the same confirm path as the console, the advisory search flag fires without changing a bid, both lots decide from real bids, and the money path funds one lot on a completed capture and closes the other at net zero.
owner_decisions: 2026-11-04: the in-run refund of a completed lot-2 capture is waived for IG-7. The refill seat's approval arrived after its offer window, so lot 2 failed with one authorization to void and no capture to refund. The live capture-then-refund-to-zero path was proven in IT-6 on this same code (capture 8J691800FS7606033 refunded to COMPLETED, zero ledger), the failure handlers are unchanged since, and the local suites cover void and refund separately. This is an owner decision, not a silent omission.
recorded_but_not_fixed: The pool stays RUNNING after both lots are terminal, which is Q-2026-11-03-26 (PS-07 has no job kind). Measured, not introduced by Phase 7.
how_to_reproduce: .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/it7_live.py --live --api-base http://127.0.0.1:8000 with loopback DATABASE_URL, PAYMENT_ROUTER=single_seller, PAYMENT_MODE=authorize_capture and IT6_BUYER_PASSWORD set; open the short loopback approval paths it prints. The harness is its own job drainer, so no worker process may run.
credential_handling: Buyer passwords stay in .env and are never printed. The harness refuses a non-loopback database and prints only short loopback approval paths; no token, client secret, full approval URL or address is recorded here.
